title: Neural Architecture Search for Improving Latency-Accuracy Trade-off in Split Computing
reasoning: The paper explicitly states that split computing addresses 'privacy and latency challenges of deploying deep learning in IoT systems' and that 'IoT sensors (e.g., visual and audio sensors) in smart home applications obtain privacy-sensitive data that should not be exposed'. The proposed method aims to reduce 'data leakage risk', which directly falls under ethical considerations regarding data privacy and protection.
